description: This module updates settings for OpenDJ with the command set-backend-prop.

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: The name of the backend on which the property needs to be updated.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The hostname of the OpenDJ server.

parameters.name: opendj_bindir
parameters.description: The path to the bin directory of OpenDJ. Default: "/opt/opendj/bin"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password for username. Either password or passwordfile is needed.

parameters.name: passwordfile
parameters.description: Location to the password file which holds the password for username. Either password or passwordfile is needed.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The Admin port on which the OpenDJ instance is available.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: If configuration needs to be added/updated. Default: "present"

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username to connect with. Default: "cn=Directory Manager"

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value for the configuration item.

examples:
- name: Add or update OpenDJ backend properties
  opendj_backendprop:
    hostname: localhost
    port: 4444
    username: "cn=Directory Manager"
    password: password
    backend: userRoot
    name: index-entry-limit
    value: 5000
